mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_change (member_id, email, code_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{email}, #{codeHash}, NOW() + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM email_change WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
SELECT id, member_id, email, code_hash, attempts FROM email_change WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND expires_at > NOW() AND attempts < 5
